#!/usr/bin/env ruby
# Container Orchestration Configuration Manager
# Handles container resource allocation and scheduling

require 'socket'
require 'json'
require 'digest'

module ContainerOrch
  MAX_CONTAINER_NAME = 64
  MAX_LABEL_SIZE = 128
  HEADER_SIZE = 16
  
  class ConfigBuffer
    attr_reader :data, :capacity
    
    def initialize(capacity)
      @capacity = capacity
      @data = "\x00" * capacity
      @write_pos = 0
    end
    
    def write(bytes)
      bytes.each_byte.with_index do |b, i|
        @data[@write_pos + i] = b.chr
      end
      @write_pos += bytes.bytesize
    end
    
    def remaining
      @capacity - @write_pos
    end
    
    def reset
      @write_pos = 0
    end
  end

  class ResourceSpec
    attr_accessor :cpu_shares, :memory_mb, :network_class
    
    def initialize(cpu: 1024, memory: 512, network: "default")
      @cpu_shares = cpu
      @memory_mb = memory
      @network_class = network
    end
    
    def serialize
      [@cpu_shares, @memory_mb].pack("NN") + @network_class.ljust(8, "\x00")[0..7]
    end
  end

  class ContainerConfig
    attr_reader :name, :labels, :resources
    
    def initialize(name, labels: {}, resources: nil)
      @name = name
      @labels = labels
      @resources = resources || ResourceSpec.new
    end
    
    def compute_scheduling_priority
      base = @resources.cpu_shares / 128
      label_boost = @labels.key?("priority") ? @labels["priority"].to_i : 0
      [base + label_boost, 255].min
    end
  end

  class OrchestrationEngine
    PROTOCOL_VERSION = 2
    MAX_BATCH_SIZE = 32
    
    def initialize
      @config_source = ENV.fetch('ORCH_CONFIG_SOURCE', 'local')
      @buffer_multiplier = ENV.fetch('ORCH_BUFFER_SCALE', '1').to_i
      @enable_label_packing = ENV.fetch('ORCH_PACK_LABELS', 'true') == 'true'
      @auth_token = ENV.fetch('ORCH_AUTH_TOKEN', '')
      @containers = []
    end
    
    def register_container(config)
      validate_container_name!(config.name)
      @containers << config
    end
    
    def build_scheduling_packet(container_configs)
      # Calculate buffer size based on environment-configured multiplier
      # The multiplier adjusts for different deployment densities
      num_configs = [container_configs.size, MAX_BATCH_SIZE].min
      
      # Header: version(2) + count(2) + auth_hash(12) = 16 bytes
      # Per-container: name(64) + labels_packed(128) + resource_spec(16) = 208
      per_container_size = MAX_CONTAINER_NAME + MAX_LABEL_SIZE + HEADER_SIZE
      
      # Buffer allocation uses multiplier from environment
      total_size = HEADER_SIZE + (per_container_size * num_configs * @buffer_multiplier)
      buffer = ConfigBuffer.new(total_size)
      
      # Write protocol header
      header = [PROTOCOL_VERSION, num_configs].pack("nn")
      header += Digest::MD5.digest(@auth_token)[0..11]
      buffer.write(header)
      
      # Serialize each container configuration
      container_configs.first(num_configs).each do |config|
        write_container_entry(buffer, config)
      end
      
      buffer
    end
    
    def process_remote_batch(raw_data)
      return nil unless raw_data.bytesize >= HEADER_SIZE
      
      version, count = raw_data[0..3].unpack("nn")
      return nil unless version == PROTOCOL_VERSION
      return nil unless count <= MAX_BATCH_SIZE
      
      auth_hash = raw_data[4..15]
      expected_hash = Digest::MD5.digest(@auth_token)[0..11]
      return nil unless secure_compare(auth_hash, expected_hash)
      
      configs = []
      offset = HEADER_SIZE
      
      count.times do |i|
        per_container_size = MAX_CONTAINER_NAME + MAX_LABEL_SIZE + HEADER_SIZE
        break if offset + per_container_size > raw_data.bytesize
        
        chunk = raw_data[offset, per_container_size]
        config = deserialize_container_entry(chunk)
        configs << config if config
        offset += per_container_size
      end
      
      configs
    end
    
    private
    
    def write_container_entry(buffer, config)
      # Name field - fixed 64 bytes
      name_bytes = config.name.encode('UTF-8').bytes
      padded_name = config.name.ljust(MAX_CONTAINER_NAME, "\x00")[0, MAX_CONTAINER_NAME]
      buffer.write(padded_name)
      
      # Labels field - pack labels into fixed 128 bytes
      if @enable_label_packing
        label_data = pack_labels(config.labels)
      else
        label_data = "\x00" * MAX_LABEL_SIZE
      end
      buffer.write(label_data)
      
      # Resource spec - 16 bytes
      buffer.write(config.resources.serialize)
    end
    
    def pack_labels(labels)
      packed = ""
      labels.each do |key, value|
        entry = "#{key}=#{value}\x00"
        packed += entry
      end
      # Pad or truncate to MAX_LABEL_SIZE
      if packed.bytesize >= MAX_LABEL_SIZE
        packed[0, MAX_LABEL_SIZE]
      else
        packed.ljust(MAX_LABEL_SIZE, "\x00")
      end
    end
    
    def deserialize_container_entry(chunk)
      name = chunk[0, MAX_CONTAINER_NAME].gsub("\x00", "").strip
      return nil if name.empty?
      
      label_data = chunk[MAX_CONTAINER_NAME, MAX_LABEL_SIZE]
      labels = unpack_labels(label_data)
      
      resource_data = chunk[MAX_CONTAINER_NAME + MAX_LABEL_SIZE, HEADER_SIZE]
      cpu, mem = resource_data[0..7].unpack("NN")
      network = resource_data[8..15].gsub("\x00", "")
      
      resources = ResourceSpec.new(cpu: cpu, memory: mem, network: network)
      ContainerConfig.new(name, labels: labels, resources: resources)
    end
    
    def unpack_labels(data)
      labels = {}
      entries = data.split("\x00").reject(&:empty?)
      entries.each do |entry|
        key, value = entry.split('=', 2)
        labels[key] = value if key && value
      end
      labels
    end
    
    def validate_container_name!(name)
      raise ArgumentError, "Name too long" if name.bytesize > MAX_CONTAINER_NAME
      raise ArgumentError, "Invalid characters" unless name.match?(/\A[a-zA-Z0-9._\-]+\z/)
    end
    
    def secure_compare(a, b)
      return false unless a.bytesize == b.bytesize
      result = 0
      a.bytes.zip(b.bytes) { |x, y| result |= x ^ y }
      result == 0
    end
  end
  
  class SchedulingServer
    def initialize(port: 9847)
      @engine = OrchestrationEngine.new
      @port = port
    end
    
    def handle_connection(client)
      raw = client.recv(65536)
      configs = @engine.process_remote_batch(raw)
      
      if configs
        configs.each { |c| @engine.register_container(c) }
        client.send([configs.size].pack("N"), 0)
      else
        client.send([0].pack("N"), 0)
      end
    rescue => e
      client.send("\xFF\xFF\xFF\xFF", 0)
    ensure
      client.close
    end
  end
end

# Entry point for testing
if __FILE__ == $0
  engine = ContainerOrch::OrchestrationEngine.new
  
  configs = 5.times.map do |i|
    ContainerOrch::ContainerConfig.new(
      "worker-#{i}",
      labels: {"tier" => "compute", "priority" => "#{i * 2}"},
      resources: ContainerOrch::ResourceSpec.new(cpu: 2048, memory: 1024)
    )
  end
  
  packet = engine.build_scheduling_packet(configs)
  puts "Built scheduling packet: #{packet.data.bytesize} bytes"
  puts "Buffer remaining: #{packet.remaining} bytes"
end
